## About {#about}

Welcome to the official home of the **BioData Basel community**, open to students, researchers, and professionals working in bioinformatics, data science, and genomics across the Basel area. We meet regularly to network, learn from each other, and explore what's new in BioData, in a relaxed setting, over talks and an apéro.

## Next event {#next-event}

<div class="protocol-card">
<div class="protocol-header">
<p class="protocol-title"><span class="run-id">06</span> Challenges in Microbial Biofilm Formation</p>
<div class="sponsor-logos">
<p class="sponsor-logos-label">with the support of</p>

<a href="https://olink.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="assets/sponsors/olink.png" alt="Olink"></a>

<p class="sponsor-sub-label">part of Thermo Fisher Scientific</p>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="protocol-meta">
<div class="protocol-meta-date"><div class="protocol-meta-date-text"><dt>date</dt><dd>2026-09-14, 17:30-19:30</dd></div><a href="6_ecoli_cdigmp/poster.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="6_ecoli_cdigmp/poster-thumb.jpg" class="poster-thumb" alt="Event 06 poster, click to view full size"></a></div>
<div><dt>venue</dt><dd>Department of Biomedicine (DBM), ZLF, Hebelstrasse 20, Basel · Seminar Room A, 2nd floor</dd></div>
<div><dt>speakers</dt><dd class="speaker-list">
<a class="speaker" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-hendrik-mallin-bd-sales-specialist/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="assets/presenter-placeholder.svg" alt=""><span><strong>Hendrik Mallin</strong><small>Olink · opening, 17:30</small></span></a>
<a class="speaker" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/vitaliia-terzova-02a466161/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="assets/presenter-placeholder.svg" alt=""><span><strong>Vitaliia Terzova</strong><small>Biozentrum, Univ. of Basel · Jenal Lab · main talk, 18:00</small></span></a>
</dd></div>
</dl>
<p class="about-card-links"><a href="https://www.meetup.com/biodata-basel/events/316000657/" class="chip-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🎟️ RSVP on Meetup →</a> <a href="https://luma.com/fm5itc90" class="chip-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📅 RSVP on Luma →</a> <a href="6_ecoli_cdigmp/poster.pdf" class="chip-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📄 poster (PDF) →</a></p>
<p>c-di-GMP is the molecular switch that flips bacteria from swimming freely to building biofilms. Hendrik Mallin from Olink (part of Thermo Fisher Scientific) opens at 17:30 with case studies and opportunities at Olink, then Vitaliia Terzova (MSc, Biozentrum, University of Basel, Jenal Lab) presents at 18:00: what happens when you remove c-di-GMP entirely from <em>E. coli</em>, covering strain engineering, whole-genome sequencing, and single-cell biosensor readouts. She built the c-di-GMP-free <em>E. coli</em> strain, then reintroduced each diguanylate cyclase individually to dissect its role. Apéro and networking follow from 18:30 to 19:30, sponsored by Olink.</p>
</div>

## Past events {#past-events}

<ol class="run-log">
<li><span class="run-id">05</span><span class="run-date">2026-06-08</span><span class="run-desc"><strong>Adipocyte segmentation in bone marrow</strong>, presented by <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/pavel-kos/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Pavel Kos</a>. Challenges of cell-type segmentation in spatial transcriptomics, using adipocyte segmentation in bone marrow as a case study: model architectures, gradient-based inputs, and preliminary U-net results. <a href="https://github.com/flalom/biodata-basel-meetup/raw/main/5_adipocyte_segmentation/adipocyte_segmentation_Pavel_Kos.pptx">slides</a></span></li>

A simplified workflow in a microbiome study, with emphasis on the challenges of combining it with bioassays. <a href="https://github.com/flalom/biodata-basel-meetup/raw/main/4_Challenges_in_Microbiome_Research/BioData_meetup_final.pptx">slides</a> · <a href="https://biodata-basel.org/4_Challenges_in_Microbiome_Research/BioData_meetup4_markdown.html">workflow</a></span></li>

<li>Direct visibility with Basel's biodata community</li>
</ul>
